Name: Unsanctioned Applications are blocked
Description: Blocks applications not approved by the organization using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Intune App Control policies. Prevents execution of unauthorized software that could introduce malware or data exfiltration risk.

Name: Configure a Next-Generation policy that protects against potentially unwanted apps (PUA)
Description: Configures Next-Generation protection policies in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to detect and block Potentially Unwanted Applications (PUA). PUA blocking prevents adware, bundlers, and grayware from running on endpoints.

Name: Only Admins shall be allowed to register 3rd party applications
Description: Restricts the ability to register new Azure AD/Entra applications to Global Administrators only. Prevents end-users from creating OAuth app registrations that could be used for malicious consent phishing.

Name: Ensure app permission policies are configured
Description: Configures app permission policies to restrict which third-party applications can access Microsoft 365 data. Limits over-permissioned app integrations that could lead to data leakage.

Name: Attack Surface Reduction rules shall be configured
Description: Enforces Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules via Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to block common attack vectors such as Office macro abuse, credential theft, and ransomware patterns.

Name: Ensure custom script execution is restricted on sites and site collections
Description: Prevents custom script execution on SharePoint sites and site collections to reduce the risk of persistent malicious scripts or unauthorized page modifications.

Name: Microsoft Edge Policies are configured and enforced
Description: Deploys and enforces Microsoft Edge security policies via Intune to ensure browser settings align with organizational security baselines and prevent risky configurations.

Name: Unnecessary browser extensions are blocked with Microsoft Defender Evidence
Description: Uses Microsoft Defender evidence to identify and block unnecessary or malicious browser extensions that could exfiltrate data or perform credential theft.

Name: Controlled Folder Access Shall be configured
Description: Configures Controlled Folder Access in Microsoft Defender to protect designated folders from unauthorized modification by ransomware or malicious processes.

Name: Real-Time behavior monitoring is enabled for Next-Gen Protection policies
Description: Enables real-time behavior monitoring in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Next-Generation Protection policies to detect and block threats as they execute.

Name: Enterprise state roaming shall be configured for Windows devices
Description: Configures Enterprise State Roaming for Windows devices via Azure AD, enabling settings and app data to sync securely across corporate devices.

Name: Configure a Next-Generation policy that protects against potentially unwanted apps (PUA)
Description: Configures Next-Generation protection to detect and block Potentially Unwanted Applications (PUA) across all enrolled endpoints. This is a duplicate policy entry ensuring comprehensive PUA coverage.

Name: Only Microsoft Office macros running from within a sandboxed environment, a Trusted Location or that are digitally signed by a Trusted Publisher are allowed to execute
Description: Restricts Microsoft Office macros to only those running from a sandboxed environment, Trusted Location, or signed by a Trusted Publisher. Prevents execution of untrusted macros that are a primary malware delivery vector.

Name: Microsoft Office macro security settings can't be changed by users
Description: Locks Microsoft Office macro security settings via Group Policy or Intune so users cannot lower security thresholds. Ensures organizational macro restrictions cannot be bypassed by end-users.

Name: Microsoft Office macros are disabled for users that do not have a demonstrated business requirement
Description: Disables Microsoft Office macros for users without a documented business requirement. Reduces the attack surface by eliminating macro execution for the majority of users.

Name: Microsoft Office macros digitally signed by an untrusted publisher can't be enabled via the Message Bar or Backstage View
Description: Prevents users from enabling untrusted-publisher macros via the Message Bar or Backstage View in Microsoft Office. Stops social engineering attacks that trick users into enabling unsigned macros.

Name: Application control for Business is implemented on workstations
Description: Implements application control (Windows Defender Application Control / AppLocker) on workstations to restrict execution to approved applications. Prevents unauthorized or malicious executables from running.

Name: Credential Guard functionality is enabled
Description: Enables Windows Credential Guard via Intune to isolate credentials in a virtualization-based secure environment. Prevents Pass-the-Hash and Pass-the-Ticket attacks by protecting LSASS.

Name: Remote Credential Guard Functionality in Enabled
Description: Enables Remote Credential Guard for RDP sessions, ensuring credentials are not sent to remote hosts. Protects against credential exposure during remote desktop access.

Name: Microsoft Office macros in files originating from the internet are blocked
Description: Blocks Microsoft Office macros in files originating from the internet (Mark of the Web) to prevent drive-by macro malware delivery.

Name: Microsoft Office macro antivirus scanning is enabled
Description: Enables antivirus scanning of Microsoft Office macros before execution to detect embedded malware. Provides an additional detection layer for macro-based threats.

Name: Internet Explorer 11 is disabled or removed
Description: Disables or removes Internet Explorer 11 from managed endpoints as it is end-of-life and no longer receives security updates. Eliminates a critical legacy attack surface.

Name: Web browsers do not process web advertisements from the internet.
Description: Configures web browsers to block processing of internet advertisements to reduce exposure to malvertising campaigns that can deliver drive-by malware.

Name: Web browsers are hardened using ASD and vendor hardening guidance, with the most restrictive guidance taking precedence when conflicts occur
Description: Hardens Microsoft Edge and other web browsers using ASD and vendor hardening guidance deployed via Intune. Reduces the browser attack surface by enforcing the most restrictive security settings.

Name: .NET Framework and PowerShell 2.0 are disabled or removed
Description: Disables or removes .NET Framework 3.5 and PowerShell 2.0, which lack modern security features and logging capabilities. Eliminates legacy components that bypass newer security controls.

Name: Microsoft Office macros are blocked from making Win32 API calls
Description: Configures ASR rules to block Microsoft Office macros from making Win32 API calls, preventing macros from directly accessing system-level functions used in malware.

Name: Microsoft Office is blocked from creating child processes
Description: Configures ASR rules to prevent Microsoft Office applications from spawning child processes, a common technique used by macro malware to execute payloads.

Name: Microsoft Office is blocked from creating executable content
Description: Configures ASR rules to block Microsoft Office from creating executable content on disk, preventing macro-based payload dropper techniques.

Name: Microsoft Office is blocked from injecting code into other processes
Description: Configures ASR rules to prevent Microsoft Office from injecting code into other processes, blocking process injection attacks originating from Office documents.

Name: Microsoft Office is configured to prevent object linking and embedding packages
Description: Configures Microsoft Office to prevent Object Linking and Embedding (OLE) package execution, blocking a common method of embedding and executing malicious files within Office documents.

Name: PDF software is blocked from creating child processes
Description: Configures ASR rules to prevent PDF software from spawning child processes, blocking PDF-based malware that attempts to execute secondary payloads.

Name: Memory integrity functionality is enabled
Description: Enables Memory Integrity (Hypervisor-Protected Code Integrity) via Intune to prevent malicious code from being inserted into high-security processes. Protects the kernel from rootkit-level attacks.

Name: Local Security Authority protection functionality is enabled
Description: Enables Local Security Authority (LSA) protection to prevent credential dumping from LSASS memory. Critical control for preventing Pass-the-Hash and mimikatz-style attacks.

Name: Application control is implemented on servers.
Description: Implements application control on servers to restrict execution to approved and signed applications. Prevents unauthorized software execution on critical server infrastructure.

Name: Application control rulesets are validated on an annual or more frequent basis.
Description: Ensures application control rulesets are reviewed and validated annually to remove stale rules and add newly approved applications. Maintains the accuracy and effectiveness of application control policies.

Name: Allowed and blocked application control events are centrally logged
Description: Ensures allowed and blocked application control events are forwarded to a central logging platform. Provides visibility into application execution attempts for threat hunting and compliance.

Name: Microsoft Office’s list of trusted publishers is validated on an annual or more frequent basis
Description: Validates Microsoft Office trusted publisher lists on an annual or more frequent basis to remove expired or compromised publishers. Prevents macros signed by untrusted publishers from executing.

Name: Web browsers do not process Java from the internet
Description: Configures web browsers to block processing of Java content from the internet to eliminate Java-based browser exploit vulnerabilities.

Name: PowerShell module logging, script block logging and transcription events are centrally logged
Description: Enables PowerShell module logging, script block logging, and transcription to capture all PowerShell activity. Critical for detecting living-off-the-land attacks and malicious script execution.

Name: Command line process creation events are centrally logged
Description: Enables command line process creation event logging (Sysmon/Windows Event 4688) to provide visibility into all process executions and their arguments.

Name: PowerShell is configured to use Constrained Language Mode
Description: Configures PowerShell to run in Constrained Language Mode to prevent advanced PowerShell-based attacks and limit access to .NET types and COM objects.

Name: Office productivity suites are hardened using ASD and vendor hardening guidance, with the most restrictive guidance taking precedence when conflicts occur
Description: Applies ASD and vendor hardening guidance to Microsoft Office productivity suites via Intune policies. Reduces the Office attack surface by enforcing the most restrictive security settings.

Name: Ensure 'User owned apps and services' is restricted
Description: Restricts users from acquiring and using apps and services outside the organization-approved catalog. Prevents shadow IT and unauthorized SaaS usage.

Name: Ensure 'third-party storage services' are restricted in 'Microsoft 365 on the web'
Description: Restricts connections to third-party cloud storage services within Microsoft 365 on the web. Prevents data exfiltration to unapproved external storage platforms.

Name: Set the default behavior for AutoRun
Description: Configures the default AutoRun behavior on Windows to disabled for all drive types. Prevents AutoRun-based malware delivery via USB drives and optical media.

Name: Office macros with non v3 signatures cant be Enabled.
Description: Prevents users from enabling Office macros that use non-v3 (legacy) digital signatures. Ensures only macros signed with modern cryptographic standards can be trusted.

Name: All Devices shall be inventoried and periodically reviewed.
Description: Maintains an up-to-date inventory of all devices in the organization using Microsoft Intune and Entra ID. Regular reviews identify unmanaged, stale, or unauthorized devices that may pose security risks.

Name: All corporate approved applications are cataloged and periodically reviewed
Description: Catalogs all corporate-approved applications and maintains this inventory through periodic reviews. Provides the foundation for application control and license management.

Name: Groups are inventoried and periodically reviewed for data access
Description: Maintains an inventory of all Microsoft 365 and Azure AD groups and reviews them periodically to verify appropriate membership and data access rights. Identifies over-privileged groups that violate least-privilege principles.

Name: An inventory of accounts in Active directory is periodically reviewed
Description: Periodically reviews Active Directory account inventory to identify stale, dormant, or unauthorized accounts. Reduces the attack surface by ensuring only active, legitimate accounts exist.

Name: An inventory of service accounts in Active directory is periodically reviewed
Description: Periodically reviews service account inventory in Active Directory to identify unused or overprivileged service accounts. Service accounts are high-value targets and must be tightly controlled.

Name: A Software Inventory is Actively Pulled from End User Devices
Description: Actively pulls software inventory from end-user devices via Microsoft Intune to maintain visibility into installed applications. Enables identification of unauthorized software and supports vulnerability management.

Name: Lockout screen and password settings shall be configured for each device
Description: Configures lockout screen and password settings on all managed devices via Intune compliance policies. Prevents unauthorized access to unattended devices and enforces organizational password requirements.

Name: Legacy Authentication shall be blocked
Description: Blocks legacy authentication protocols (IMAP, POP, SMTP AUTH, basic auth) that do not support modern MFA. Legacy auth is the primary vector for credential-stuffing attacks against M365 tenants.

Name: Passwords shall not expire
Description: Configures Microsoft 365 password policies so passwords do not expire on a scheduled basis. Aligns with NIST guidance: expiring passwords increase risk as users choose weaker, predictable passwords.

Name: MFA is enforced for all users
Description: Enforces Multi-Factor Authentication for all users via Conditional Access policies. MFA is the single most effective control against identity-based attacks, blocking over 99% of account compromise attempts.

Name: MFA is enforced for Azure Management
Description: Requires MFA for all Azure Management portal and API access. Prevents attackers who obtain credentials from accessing Azure subscriptions and infrastructure without a second factor.

Name: MFA shall be required to enroll devices to Entra ID
Description: Requires MFA as a prerequisite for enrolling new devices into Entra ID. Prevents unauthorized device registration using compromised credentials.

Name: MFA Shall be required for Intune Enrollment
Description: Requires MFA for Intune device enrollment to ensure only authenticated users can register devices into the MDM platform. Prevents unauthorized MDM enrollment.

Name: Windows Hello for Business should be configured where applicable
Description: Configures Windows Hello for Business as a phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication method on supported Windows devices. Replaces passwords with cryptographically strong key-based authentication.

Name: Authorized Applications shall be configured for Single Sign-On
Description: Configures authorized applications for Single Sign-On through Microsoft Entra ID. Reduces password sprawl and enables centralized access control and session management.

Name: Leverage Entra ID as your primary IDP for authentication and SSO
Description: Establishes Microsoft Entra ID as the primary Identity Provider for all authentication and SSO scenarios. Centralizes identity management and enables consistent security policy enforcement.

Name: MFA registration and usage shall be periodically reviewed
Description: Periodically reviews MFA registration and usage reports to identify users without MFA configured and accounts showing unusual authentication patterns.

Name: Users are enrolled in MFA and covered by a policy
Description: Verifies that all users are enrolled in MFA and covered by an active Conditional Access MFA policy. Identifies gaps in MFA coverage that leave accounts vulnerable.

Name: Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate users to their organization’s online customer services that process, store or communicate their organization’s sensitive customer data.
Description: Requires MFA for users accessing online customer services that process, store, or communicate sensitive customer data. Protects customer data repositories from unauthorized access.

Name: Require Device Bound Token Protection
Description: Requires Device Bound Token Protection in Conditional Access to prevent token theft and replay attacks. Binds authentication tokens to specific devices, making stolen tokens unusable on other devices.

Name: Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate customers to online customer services that process, store or communicate sensitive customer data.
Description: Requires MFA for customer-facing authentication to online services handling sensitive customer data. Ensures customers are protected against account takeover in addition to internal users.

Name: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) is configured for all users
Description: Configures Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) for all users to reduce helpdesk burden while maintaining security. Requires at least two authentication methods for SSPR to prevent account hijacking.

Name: Change passwords routinely
Description: Establishes a routine password change process for scenarios where passwords must be rotated, such as after suspected compromise. Supports rapid credential rotation in incident response.

Name: Implement a password manager system
Description: Implements and enforces use of a password manager to encourage strong, unique passwords for all accounts. Reduces password reuse risk across personal and corporate accounts.

Name: MFA on all business applications and social media accounts
Description: Enforces MFA on all business applications and social media accounts to protect brand accounts and business systems from unauthorized access.

Name: MFA on all business applications and social media accounts-No weak MFA
Description: Ensures MFA on business applications excludes weak MFA methods (SMS, voice) in favor of authenticator apps or hardware tokens. Prevents SIM-swapping and SS7-based MFA bypass attacks.

Name: Update User Risk on Password Change
Description: Configures Entra ID Identity Protection to automatically update user risk levels when passwords are changed, ensuring risk-based policies remain accurate.

Name: Ensure 'Per-user MFA' is disabled
Description: Disables legacy per-user MFA in favor of Conditional Access-based MFA policies. Per-user MFA is less flexible and does not support granular policy conditions available in Conditional Access.

Name: Ensure that password hash sync is enabled for hybrid deployments
Description: Ensures password hash synchronization is enabled for hybrid Azure AD deployments. Enables Entra ID Identity Protection to detect leaked credentials and supports seamless SSO.

Name: Ensure sign-in frequency for Intune Enrollment is set to 'Every time'
Description: Sets sign-in frequency for Intune Enrollment Conditional Access policy to require re-authentication every time. Prevents session token reuse for device enrollment operations.

Name: Ensure the device code sign-in flow is blocked
Description: Blocks the device code sign-in flow via Conditional Access to prevent device code phishing attacks where attackers trick users into authenticating on attacker-controlled devices.

Name: Ensure Microsoft Authenticator is configured to protect against MFA fatigue
Description: Configures Microsoft Authenticator with number matching and additional context to prevent MFA fatigue attacks. Requires users to match a displayed number to approve authentication requests.

Name: Ensure custom banned passwords lists are used
Description: Enables a custom banned password list in Entra ID Password Protection to prevent use of organization-specific weak passwords. Supplements the Microsoft global banned password list.

Name: Ensure password protection is enabled for on-prem Active Directory
Description: Enables Entra ID Password Protection for on-premises Active Directory to enforce the same banned password lists used in the cloud. Prevents weak passwords from being set in hybrid environments.

Name: Ensure all member users are 'MFA capable'
Description: Verifies that all member users are MFA-capable by having at least one strong authentication method registered. Identifies accounts that cannot satisfy MFA requirements when policies are enforced.

Name: Ensure system-preferred multifactor authentication is enabled
Description: Enables system-preferred MFA to automatically guide users toward the strongest available authentication method. Ensures users don't default to weaker methods like SMS when stronger options are available.

Name: Tenant has migrated from Legacy MFA and SSPR
Description: Migrates the tenant from legacy per-user MFA and legacy SSPR to the unified Authentication Methods Policy. Enables centralized management of all authentication methods in Entra ID.

Name: Ensure modern authentication for SharePoint applications is required
Description: Requires modern authentication (OAuth 2.0/OIDC) for SharePoint Online access to ensure MFA and Conditional Access policies are enforced for SharePoint. Blocks basic auth access to SharePoint.

Name: Ensure reauthentication with verification code is restricted
Description: Restricts reauthentication with verification codes to prevent verification code sharing and relay attacks. Ensures authentication codes are bound to the authenticating session.

Name: Users Are Authenticated with Unique Credentials
Description: Ensures all users authenticate with unique individual credentials rather than shared accounts. Provides accountability and enables accurate audit trail attribution.

Name: Ensure custom banned passwords lists are used
Description: Enables a custom banned password list in Entra ID to prevent common and organization-specific weak passwords. This is a duplicate control reinforcing the banned password requirement.

Name: Passwordless Authenticaiton is leveraged
Description: Enables passwordless authentication methods (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Microsoft Authenticator) as the primary sign-in method. Eliminates password-based attacks entirely for enrolled users.

Name: Define a data recovery process for data repositories
Description: Defines and documents a formal data recovery process for all critical data repositories. Ensures the organization can restore operations within defined RTO/RPO objectives following data loss.

Name: Configure Microsoft 365 Backup Policies
Description: Configures Microsoft 365 Backup policies to protect Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive data. Provides native Microsoft backup capabilities with granular restore options.

Name: Maintain 3rd party backups of Microsoft 365 data
Description: Maintains third-party backups of Microsoft 365 data to provide an independent recovery option not subject to Microsoft platform issues. Enables recovery even if the Microsoft 365 tenant is compromised.

Name: Backup and recovery procedures in place for all important business and customer data
Description: Ensures backup and recovery procedures are in place for all important business and customer data. Documents the backup strategy, retention periods, and recovery procedures.

Name: Access to backups is restricted based on role and least privilege
Description: Restricts access to backup storage and management interfaces based on role and least privilege. Prevents ransomware from deleting backups by limiting who can modify or delete backup data.

Name: Backups of data, applications and settings are synchronized to enable restoration to a common point in time.
Description: Ensures backups of data, applications, and settings are synchronized to enable restoration to a common point in time. Critical for consistent recovery of interdependent systems after a disaster.

Name: Restoration of data, applications and settings from backups to a common point in time is tested as part of disaster recovery exercises.
Description: Regularly tests restoration of data, applications, and settings as part of disaster recovery exercises. Untested backups may fail when needed; testing validates recovery capabilities.

Name: Backups are protected from modification and deletion by all users, including administrators, during their defined retention period
Description: Protects backups from modification or deletion by all users, including administrators, during their defined retention period. Immutable backups ensure ransomware cannot destroy recovery capability.

Name: Backups of data, applications and settings are retained in a secure and resilient manner
Description: Ensures backups are stored in a secure, resilient manner with appropriate encryption and geographic redundancy. Protects backup data from unauthorized access and hardware failures.

Name: Implement a backup and recovery strategy for important digital assets
Description: Implements a comprehensive backup and recovery strategy for all critical digital assets. Provides the governance framework for backup operations and recovery priorities.

Name: Ensure 'Access reviews' for Guest Users are configured
Description: Configures periodic access reviews for guest users in Entra ID to ensure only authorized guests retain access. Automatically removes access for guests who no longer require it.

Name: A conditional access policy is enabled which requires guest users to use MFA
Description: Enforces MFA for all guest users accessing Microsoft 365 resources via Conditional Access. Prevents compromised guest accounts from accessing organizational resources without a second factor.

Name: Network access via Conditional Access is documented and periodically reviewed
Description: Documents and periodically reviews all Conditional Access policies controlling network access. Ensures CA policies remain accurate and effective as the environment evolves.

Name: Conditional Access Policies are configured for access controls
Description: Configures Conditional Access policies to enforce access controls based on user, device, location, and application risk signals. Provides the core Zero Trust enforcement mechanism for M365.

Name: Global Secure Access is configured as needed
Description: Configures Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to provide secure, identity-aware network access to applications and resources. Replaces VPN with a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) model.

Name: Ensure 'sign-in risk' is blocked for medium and high risk
Description: Configures a Conditional Access policy to block or require MFA for sign-ins with medium or high sign-in risk scores. Prevents access from compromised or suspicious sign-in contexts.

Name: Noncompliant devices shall be blocked from accessing corporate resources.
Description: Blocks noncompliant devices from accessing corporate resources via Conditional Access device compliance policies. Ensures only managed, healthy devices can access M365 services.

Name: Entra ID Application Proxy is configured for on-premise applications
Description: Configures Entra ID Application Proxy to provide secure remote access to on-premises applications without VPN. Enables Zero Trust access to internal apps through Entra ID authentication.

Name: Block unmanaged devices from signing in
Description: Blocks sign-ins from unmanaged (non-Intune enrolled) devices from accessing corporate resources. Enforces device management as a prerequisite for corporate resource access.

Name: Block access outside your country's IP
Description: Creates a Conditional Access policy blocking access from IP addresses outside the organization's country. Reduces the attack surface from international credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks.

Name: Block Unknown OS
Description: Blocks sign-ins from unknown or unsupported operating systems via Conditional Access. Prevents access from unmanaged or unusual device platforms that cannot be validated for compliance.

Name: Block Mac OS
Description: Blocks macOS device sign-ins via Conditional Access where macOS is not an approved platform. Enforces the approved device platform policy.

Name: Require hybrid domain joined for Windows OS
Description: Requires Windows devices to be hybrid Azure AD joined as a condition for accessing corporate resources. Ensures Windows devices are managed and domain-joined before granting access.

Name: Require App protection policy for Android/iOS
Description: Requires Intune App Protection policies to be applied for Android and iOS devices accessing corporate resources. Ensures mobile devices have data protection controls even without full MDM enrollment.

Name: Block external users from all resources except Microsoft Rights Management Services
Description: Blocks external/guest users from accessing all resources except Microsoft Rights Management Services via Conditional Access. Minimizes the data exposure surface for external identities.

Name: Define Trusted Named Locations for your Organization
Description: Defines trusted named locations (IP ranges, country codes) in Entra ID for use in Conditional Access policies. Enables location-based access controls and reduces noise in risk-based policies.

Name: Ensure Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) occurs only over Virtual Private Network (VPN) connections
Description: Enforces that Remote Desktop Protocol connections occur only over VPN connections via network access controls. Prevents RDP exposure directly to the internet.

Name: MFA on VPN connections
Description: Requires MFA for all VPN connection authentication to prevent compromised VPN credentials from providing direct network access.

Name: MFA on VPN connections-No weak MFA
Description: Requires phishing-resistant or strong MFA (not SMS/voice) for VPN connections. Prevents VPN MFA bypass via SIM-swapping or SS7 attacks.

Name: MFA on RDP connections
Description: Requires MFA for all RDP connection authentication to prevent unauthorized remote desktop access using stolen credentials.

Name: MFA on RDP connections-No Weak MFA
Description: Requires phishing-resistant or strong MFA (not SMS/voice) for RDP connections. Prevents RDP MFA bypass via SIM-swapping or SS7 attacks.

Name: Enable Identity Protection sign-in risk policies
Description: Enables Entra ID Identity Protection sign-in risk policies to automatically respond to risky sign-ins with MFA challenges or access blocks.

Name: Ensure 'Access reviews' for privileged roles are configured
Description: Configures periodic access reviews for privileged roles in Entra ID PIM to ensure only authorized users retain elevated permissions. Automatically removes access for principals who no longer need it.

Name: Teams/Teams Channels are documented and periodically reviewed
Description: Documents and periodically reviews all Microsoft Teams and Teams Channels to identify inactive or overly permissive teams. Ensures collaboration spaces are governed and access is appropriate.

Name: Teams/Teams channel creation is restricted
Description: Restricts the creation of Teams and Teams Channels to authorized users or groups to prevent ungoverned collaboration spaces. Reduces the risk of sensitive data being shared in unmanaged channels.

Name: SharePoint Sites are documented and Periodically reviewed
Description: Documents and periodically reviews all SharePoint sites to identify sites with inappropriate permissions or inactive status. Ensures SharePoint governance and data access control.

Name: Ensure link sharing is restricted in SharePoint and OneDrive
Description: Restricts link sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive to organization-specific links or people with existing access. Prevents accidental external sharing of sensitive documents.

Name: Ensure SharePoint external sharing is managed through domain whitelist/blacklists
Description: Manages SharePoint external sharing through domain whitelist/blacklist controls. Limits external sharing to approved partner domains and blocks known malicious domains.

Name: Ensure external participants can't give or request control
Description: Prevents external meeting participants from requesting or receiving screen control during Teams meetings. Reduces risk of unauthorized access to screen content by external participants.

Name: Ensure anonymous users and dial-in callers can't start a meeting
Description: Prevents anonymous users and dial-in callers from starting Teams meetings without an authenticated user present. Ensures all meetings are controlled by authenticated organizers.

Name: Ensure communication with Skype users is disabled
Description: Disables Teams communication with Skype consumer users to reduce the external communication attack surface. Prevents unknown external users from initiating contact with internal users via Skype federation.

Name: Ensure external file sharing in Teams is enabled for only approved cloud storage services
Description: Restricts external file sharing in Teams to only approved cloud storage services. Prevents data exfiltration through unapproved file sharing integrations.

Name: Ensure 'External sharing' of calendars is not available
Description: Disables external sharing of Outlook calendar details to prevent disclosure of meeting schedules and attendee information to external parties.

Name: Ensure OneDrive sync is restricted for unmanaged devices
Description: Restricts OneDrive sync to managed, domain-joined devices only. Prevents corporate data from syncing to unmanaged personal devices.

Name: Teams/Teams Channels are documented and periodically reviewed
Description: Documents and periodically reviews all Microsoft Teams and Teams Channels for governance compliance. Duplicate review process ensuring comprehensive coverage of all Teams environments.

Name: Teams/Teams channel creation is restricted
Description: Restricts Teams and Teams Channel creation to authorized users. Duplicate control reinforcing channel creation governance.

Name: Ensure SharePoint and OneDrive integration with Azure AD B2B is enabled
Description: Enables SharePoint and OneDrive integration with Azure AD B2B for external sharing to ensure guest access is managed through Entra ID. Provides consistent identity governance for external collaborators.

Name: Ensure external content sharing is restricted
Description: Restricts external content sharing across Microsoft 365 services to approved domains and user groups. Implements a comprehensive data egress control for external collaboration.

Name: Ensure OneDrive content sharing is restricted
Description: Restricts OneDrive content sharing capabilities to prevent oversharing of personal OneDrive content. Ensures OneDrive sharing settings align with organizational data governance policies.

Name: Ensure that SharePoint guest users cannot share items they don't own
Description: Prevents SharePoint guest users from sharing items they do not own to stop guests from redistributing organizational content to unauthorized parties.

Name: Ensure external sharing is restricted by security group
Description: Restricts external sharing to specific security groups whose members are authorized for external collaboration. Provides fine-grained control over who can share externally.

Name: Ensure the SharePoint default sharing link permission is set
Description: Configures the default SharePoint sharing link type to restrict sharing to specific people or the organization. Prevents accidental creation of anonymous 'Anyone' sharing links.

Name: Ensure Office 365 SharePoint infected files are disallowed for download
Description: Disallows download of infected files detected by Safe Attachments in SharePoint Online and OneDrive. Prevents malware distribution via file sharing platforms.

Name: Ensure anonymous users can't join a meeting
Description: Configures Teams meeting policies to prevent anonymous users from joining meetings. Ensures all meeting participants are authenticated identities.

Name: Ensure meeting chat does not allow anonymous users
Description: Configures Teams meeting policies to prevent anonymous users from participating in meeting chat. Ensures meeting chat is restricted to authenticated participants.

Name: Ensure external meeting chat is off
Description: Disables external meeting chat in Microsoft Teams to prevent communication with external parties through meeting chat channels. Reduces data leakage risk.

Name: Ensure meeting recording is off by default
Description: Sets meeting recording to off by default in Microsoft Teams to prevent inadvertent recording of sensitive conversations. Recording must be explicitly enabled when needed.

Name: Ensure users can report security concerns in Teams
Description: Enables users to report security concerns (phishing, malicious content) directly from Microsoft Teams. Improves threat detection by leveraging user reporting.

Name: Ensure guest user access is restricted in Microsoft Fabric
Description: Restricts guest user access to Microsoft Fabric workspaces and content. Prevents unauthorized external access to business intelligence and analytics data.

Name: Ensure external user invitations are restricted
Description: Restricts the ability to invite external users to Microsoft 365 resources to authorized roles only. Prevents unrestricted external user invitation that could lead to unauthorized data access.

Name: Ensure guest access to content is restricted for Microsoft Fabric
Description: Restricts guest access to Microsoft Fabric content to prevent unauthorized external access to analytical data and reports.

Name: Ensure 'Publish to web' is restricted
Description: Restricts the 'Publish to web' feature in Microsoft Fabric/Power BI to prevent public internet exposure of reports containing potentially sensitive data.

Name: Ensure shareable links are restricted for Microsoft Fabric
Description: Restricts creation of shareable links in Microsoft Fabric to prevent uncontrolled distribution of analytics content and dashboards.

Name: Ensure enabling of external data sharing is restricted for Microsoft Fabric
Description: Restricts external data sharing capabilities in Microsoft Fabric to prevent sensitive business data from being shared with unauthorized external parties.

Name: Ensure 'Block ResourceKey Authentication' is 'Enabled'
Description: Enables 'Block ResourceKey Authentication' in Microsoft Fabric to prevent embed tokens from bypassing Entra ID authentication. Ensures all Fabric content access is authenticated.

Name: Ensure shared bookings paged are restricted to select users
Description: Restricts shared Bookings pages to select authorized users to prevent exposing internal schedules to external parties without proper authorization.

Name: Ensure the organization cannot communicate with accounts in trial Teams tenants
Description: Configures Teams federation settings to prevent communication with accounts in trial Teams tenants, which are often used for phishing and social engineering.

Name: OneDrive Sync Requirement
Description: Restricts OneDrive sync to require devices to be domain-joined or meet compliance requirements. Prevents syncing of corporate data to unmanaged personal devices.

Name: A data management process is defined for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
Description: Defines and documents a data management process for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive including data classification, retention, and governance policies. Provides the foundation for data protection controls.

Name: Retention Policies shall be configured
Description: Configures Microsoft Purview retention policies for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams to ensure data is retained for required periods and deleted when no longer needed. Supports compliance and legal hold requirements.

Name: Groups are set up for expiration
Description: Configures Microsoft 365 group expiration policies to automatically remove inactive groups after a defined period. Reduces data sprawl and unauthorized access through abandoned group memberships.

Name: Teams channels are set up for expiration due to inactivity
Description: Configures Teams channels for automatic expiration when inactive for a defined period. Reduces governance burden and prevents sensitive data from remaining in abandoned collaboration spaces.

Name: Encryption shall be required on all devices
Description: Enforces device encryption (BitLocker for Windows, FileVault for macOS) on all managed devices via Intune. Protects data at rest if a device is lost or stolen.

Name: Information Protection Labels shall be configured
Description: Configures Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels with appropriate protection settings. Labels drive data classification and enable downstream DLP, encryption, and access control enforcement.

Name: Configure an endpoint protection configuration profile for removeable data drives
Description: Configures Intune endpoint protection profiles to control removable storage device access and encryption requirements. Prevents data exfiltration via USB drives and removable media.

Name: Ensure that only organizationally managed/approved public groups exist
Description: Ensures all Microsoft 365 groups with public visibility are organizationally managed and approved. Prevents sensitive data exposure through unapproved public groups.

Name: Sensitive SharePoint Sites SHOULD Adjust Their Default Sharing Settings to Those Best Aligning to Their Sensitivity Level
Description: Configures sensitive SharePoint sites to use sharing settings appropriate for their sensitivity level. Ensures high-sensitivity sites have more restrictive sharing than general-purpose sites.

Name: Data loss prevention policies shall be configured
Description: Configures Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies to detect and block unauthorized transfer of sensitive data. DLP is critical for preventing accidental or malicious data exfiltration.

Name: Ensure guest access to a site or OneDrive will expire automatically
Description: Configures SharePoint and OneDrive to automatically expire guest access after a defined period. Prevents permanent guest access accumulation from collaboration activities.

Name: Expiration Date SHOULD Be Set for Anyone Links
Description: Sets expiration dates on 'Anyone' anonymous sharing links in SharePoint and OneDrive. Ensures anonymous access does not persist indefinitely and requires periodic renewal.

Name: Ensure DLP policies are enabled for Microsoft Teams
Description: Enables DLP policies specifically for Microsoft Teams to detect and block sharing of sensitive data in Teams chats and channels.

Name: Ensure 'Interact with and share R and Python' visuals is 'Disabled'
Description: Disables the ability for users to interact with and share R and Python visuals in Power BI/Fabric. Prevents potential data exfiltration through embedded code in reports.

Name: Ensure 'Allow users to apply sensitivity labels for content' is 'Enabled'
Description: Enables users to apply Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels directly to content in Microsoft 365 applications. Empowers users to participate in data classification while policies enforce minimum standards.

Name: An email encryption policy is configured
Description: Configures email encryption policies to protect sensitive email content in transit and at rest using Microsoft Purview Message Encryption. Ensures sensitive communications are protected from interception.

Name: Configure the Authentication Methods Policy to disable SMS and Email methods
Description: Configures the Authentication Methods Policy to disable SMS and email OTP as MFA methods. These methods are vulnerable to SIM-swapping and phishing; stronger methods should be used instead.

Name: Ensure sign-in to shared mailboxes is blocked
Description: Blocks direct sign-in to shared mailboxes to prevent their use as anonymous attack vectors. Shared mailboxes should only be accessed via delegation from authenticated accounts.

Name: Ensure 'Phishing-resistant MFA strength' is required for Administrators
Description: Configures a Conditional Access policy requiring phishing-resistant MFA strength for all administrator accounts. Ensures admins use FIDO2 or Windows Hello for Business rather than weaker MFA methods.

Name: Ensure the spoofed domains report is reviewed weekly
Description: Reviews the Microsoft Defender for Office 365 spoofed domains report on a weekly basis to identify spoofing activity targeting the organization.

Name: Reported phishing or suspicious emails messages are periodically reviewed
Description: Periodically reviews reported phishing and suspicious email messages to identify threats and improve detection rules. User-reported phishing provides valuable threat intelligence.

Name: Ensure DMARC Records for all Exchange Online domains are published
Description: Configures and publishes DMARC records (with p=quarantine or p=reject policy) for all Exchange Online domains. DMARC prevents domain spoofing and provides reporting on email authentication failures.

Name: Ensure that SPF records are published for all Exchange Domains
Description: Publishes SPF records for all Exchange Online domains to authorize legitimate mail senders. SPF prevents unauthorized servers from sending email as your domain.

Name: Ensure that DKIM is enabled for all Exchange Online Domains
Description: Enables DKIM signing for all Exchange Online domains to cryptographically authenticate outbound email. DKIM prevents email tampering and domain spoofing.

Name: Ensure the Common Attachment Types Filter is enabled
Description: Enables the Common Attachment Types Filter in Exchange Online anti-malware policies to block dangerous file types. Prevents delivery of executable and script-based attachments.

Name: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) for malware SHOULD be enabled in the default antimalware policy and in all existing custom policies.
Description: Enables Zero-Hour Auto Purge (ZAP) for malware in default and custom anti-malware policies. ZAP retroactively removes malware detected in already-delivered emails from user mailboxes.

Name: Safe Attachment Policies are configured
Description: Configures Safe Attachment policies in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 to sandbox email attachments before delivery. Detects and blocks zero-day malware in attachments.

Name: Ensure Priority account Protection is enabled and configured
Description: Enables Priority Account Protection for executive and high-risk accounts to apply enhanced threat protection and monitoring. Priority accounts receive extra scrutiny for targeted attacks.

Name: Ensure that an anti-phishing policy has been created
Description: Creates anti-phishing policies in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 with impersonation protection and spoof intelligence enabled. Protects users from business email compromise and spear-phishing.

Name: Ensure email from external senders is identified
Description: Configures Exchange Online to visually identify emails from external senders (external email warning banners). Helps users identify potentially suspicious messages from outside the organization.

Name: Ensure mail transport rules do not whitelist specific domains
Description: Ensures mail transport rules do not whitelist entire domains, which would bypass anti-spam and anti-malware checks. Domain whitelisting creates exploitable bypass paths for attackers.

Name: Inbound Anti-Spam Protections SHALL Be Enabled.
Description: Enables inbound anti-spam protections in Exchange Online including spam confidence level (SCL) thresholds and quarantine policies. Prevents spam from reaching user mailboxes.

Name: Ensure the connection filter IP allow list is not used
Description: Verifies the Connection Filter IP Allow List is empty to ensure no IP addresses bypass anti-spam and anti-malware scanning. IP allowlisting creates exploitable bypass paths.

Name: Safe Links policies are configured
Description: Configures Safe Links policies in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 to scan and rewrite URLs in emails and Office documents. Protects users from clicking malicious links in phishing emails.

Name: Safe Links and Safe Attachment policies are configured
Description: Configures both Safe Links and Safe Attachments policies in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 to provide comprehensive email threat protection for all users.

Name: Microsoft Report Message or the Report Phishing add-ins shall be installed
Description: Deploys the Microsoft Report Message or Report Phishing add-in to enable users to report suspicious emails directly to Microsoft. User reports improve organizational threat intelligence and detection.

Name: There are no licensed shared mailboxes
Description: Verifies that shared mailboxes are not assigned user licenses, as licensed shared mailboxes can sign in directly. Removes the security risk of direct authentication to shared accounts.

Name: Multi-factor authentication used for authenticating users of systems is phishing-resistant
Description: Requires phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business) for authenticating users to business systems. Ensures the highest assurance level for system authentication.

Name: Ensure internal phishing protection for Forms is enabled
Description: Enables internal phishing protection in Microsoft Forms to detect and block phishing forms created within the tenant. Prevents Forms from being used as internal phishing infrastructure.

Name: Ensure the customer lockbox feature is enabled
Description: Enables the Customer Lockbox feature to require explicit approval for Microsoft support engineers to access tenant data. Provides an additional control layer for data access by Microsoft personnel.

Name: Ensure that Sways cannot be shared with people outside of your organization
Description: Restricts Sway sharing to prevent organizational content from being shared with people outside the organization. Prevents sensitive Sway presentations from being publicly accessible.

Name: Ensure notifications for internal users sending malware is Enabled
Description: Enables notifications to administrators when internal users send malware. Provides immediate awareness of potentially compromised internal accounts sending malicious content.

Name: Ensure Exchange Online Spam Policies are set to notify administrators
Description: Configures Exchange Online spam policies to notify administrators when users are blocked for sending spam. Enables rapid response to compromised accounts being used for spam campaigns.

Name: Ensure the connection filter safe list is off
Description: Ensures the connection filter safe list is empty to prevent mail from safe-listed IPs bypassing security scanning. Safe-listed IPs create exploitable exceptions in email security.

Name: Ensure inbound anti-spam policies do not contain allowed domains
Description: Verifies inbound anti-spam policies do not contain allowed sender domains, which would bypass spam filtering for spoofed messages from those domains.

Name: Ensure Priority accounts have 'Strict protection' presets applied
Description: Applies Strict Protection preset security policies to Priority Accounts in Microsoft Defender for Office 365. Provides maximum protection for the highest-risk accounts in the organization.

Name: Ensure Zero-hour auto purge for Microsoft Teams is on
Description: Enables Zero-Hour Auto Purge (ZAP) for Microsoft Teams to retroactively remove malware and phishing content detected in Teams messages after delivery.

Name: Ensure mailbox audit actions are configured
Description: Configures mailbox audit actions to capture all significant mailbox access and modification events. Provides an audit trail for forensic investigation of mailbox-related security incidents.

Name: Ensure 'AuditBypassEnabled' is not enabled on mailboxes
Description: Verifies that AuditBypassEnabled is not set on any mailboxes, which would prevent mailbox actions from being audited. Audit bypass creates blind spots in email forensics.

Name: Ensure all forms of mail forwarding are blocked and/or disabled
Description: Blocks all forms of automatic email forwarding including SMTP forwarding rules, mailbox forwarding settings, and client-side rules. Prevents data exfiltration and account compromise detection evasion via forwarding.

Name: Ensure users installing Outlook add-ins is not allowed
Description: Prevents users from installing Outlook add-ins from the Office Store without administrator approval. Reduces risk of malicious add-ins that can access email content.

Name: Ensure modern authentication for Exchange Online is enabled
Description: Ensures modern authentication (OAuth 2.0) is enabled for Exchange Online to support MFA and Conditional Access enforcement for email clients.

Name: Ensure MailTips are enabled for end users
Description: Enables MailTips in Exchange Online to provide users with contextual warnings before sending emails to large groups, external recipients, or restricted addresses. Reduces accidental data disclosure.

Name: Ensure SMTP AUTH is disabled
Description: Disables SMTP AUTH protocol for the entire Exchange Online organization. SMTP AUTH allows legacy clients to send email without modern auth and MFA, creating an attack vector.

Name: Ensure users can't send emails to a channel email address
Description: Prevents users from sending emails directly to Teams channel email addresses to maintain control over content entering Teams channels.

Name: Ensure outbound anti-spam message limits are in place
Description: Configures outbound anti-spam message limits to prevent compromised accounts from sending large volumes of spam. Rate limiting reduces the blast radius of compromised accounts.

Name: Ensure the email OTP authentication method is disabled
Description: Disables the email OTP authentication method to prevent use of one-time passwords delivered via email as MFA. Email OTP is vulnerable to account compromise if email is already compromised.

Name: Ensure Direct Send submissions are rejected
Description: Configures Exchange Online to reject direct send submissions that bypass standard email security controls. Prevents internal mail relay abuse.

Name: Devices shall be deleted that haven't checked in for over 45 days.
Description: Configures automatic deletion of devices from Intune and Entra ID that have not checked in for over 45 days. Maintains a clean, accurate device inventory and removes stale device records.

Name: Managed Devices shall be required for authentication
Description: Requires managed devices as a condition for authentication in Conditional Access policies. Ensures only enrolled, compliant devices can access corporate resources.

Name: Personal Devices should be restricted from enrolling into the MDM solution
Description: Restricts personal (BYOD) devices from enrolling into the MDM solution to maintain separation between personal and corporate device management.

Name: Microsoft Intune is configured for Autoenrollment
Description: Configures Microsoft Intune for automatic MDM enrollment for all Azure AD-joined Windows devices. Ensures all corporate Windows devices are automatically enrolled and managed.

Name: Mobile devices shall only be able to access corporate data through approved client apps
Description: Requires mobile devices to access corporate data only through approved client apps with Intune App Protection policies. Enables data protection without requiring full device enrollment.

Name: Authorized Applications should be deployed to managed devices
Description: Deploys authorized corporate applications to all managed devices via Intune app deployment. Ensures users have access to required tools while maintaining software inventory control.

Name: Security Baselines should be configured for Windows Devices
Description: Deploys Microsoft security baselines for Windows devices via Intune to enforce hundreds of security settings at once. Security baselines represent Microsoft's recommended security configuration.

Name: Devices compliance policies shall be configured for every supported device platform
Description: Configures Intune device compliance policies for every supported device platform (Windows, iOS, Android, macOS). Establishes minimum health and security requirements for device access.

Name: Ensure 'Idle session timeout' is set to '3 hours (or less)' for unmanaged devices
Description: Configures idle session timeout of 3 hours or less for unmanaged devices accessing M365 via browser. Reduces risk of session hijacking on unmanaged devices left unattended.

Name: Firewall Policies are configured for Windows Devices
Description: Deploys Windows Defender Firewall policies via Intune to ensure firewalls are enabled and configured consistently across all managed Windows devices.

Name: Turn on Tamper Protection
Description: Enables Tamper Protection in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to prevent attackers or malware from disabling security features. Critical for maintaining endpoint protection integrity.

Name: Devices and Applications shall be wiped when a user leaves the organization or reports a lost/stolen device
Description: Configures Intune device wipe and selective wipe capabilities to remove corporate data when a user leaves or reports a lost/stolen device. Prevents data exposure from off-boarded users or lost devices.

Name: App Protection policies should be created for mobile devices
Description: Creates Intune App Protection policies for iOS and Android to enforce data protection controls on mobile devices. Prevents corporate data leakage from mobile applications.

Name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is deployed via Intune
Description: Deploys Microsoft Defender Antivirus configuration profiles via Intune to ensure consistent antivirus settings across all managed Windows devices.

Name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is deployed and managed through Microsoft Intune
Description: Manages Microsoft Defender Antivirus entirely through Microsoft Intune to ensure centralized policy enforcement and reporting. Duplicate control emphasizing Intune as the management plane.

Name: Devices shall be enrolled for Defender for Business or Defender for Endpoint
Description: Enrolls all managed devices into Microsoft Defender for Business or Defender for Endpoint for advanced threat protection. Provides EDR capabilities across the device fleet.

Name: Remediation steps are acted upon between Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Intune
Description: Ensures remediation actions from Microsoft Defender alerts are acted upon in Microsoft Intune to bring noncompliant devices into compliance. Closes the loop between threat detection and device remediation.

Name: Compliance Policies are configured to incorporate Defender settings
Description: Configures Intune compliance policies to incorporate Microsoft Defender security health requirements. Devices with active threats or disabled Defender features are marked noncompliant.

Name: Managed Devices are enrolled in MDM
Description: Ensures all managed devices are enrolled in an MDM solution (Microsoft Intune). Provides the foundation for all endpoint security policy enforcement.

Name: All Managed Devices shall be enrolled in Intune
Description: Ensures all managed devices are enrolled in Microsoft Intune specifically, enabling centralized management and policy enforcement.

Name: All Devices are Enrolled into Defender for Business
Description: Enrolls all devices into Microsoft Defender for Business to provide antivirus, EDR, and threat intelligence capabilities for smaller organizations.

Name: Limit device enrollment to 5 per user
Description: Limits the number of devices each user can enroll in Intune to 5 to prevent device proliferation and maintain enrollment control.

Name: Ensure devices without a compliance policy are marked 'not compliant'
Description: Configures the Intune default compliance policy to mark devices without an assigned compliance policy as 'not compliant'. Ensures no device can access resources without meeting compliance requirements.

Name: Ensure a managed device is required to register security information
Description: Requires a managed device as a prerequisite for registering security information (MFA methods) in Entra ID. Prevents registration of authentication methods from unmanaged devices.

Name: Windows Autopilot Profiles are leveraged for Local Account Control
Description: Uses Windows Autopilot profiles to configure local account settings during device provisioning. Ensures standard local account configurations are applied consistently.

Name: Ensure the ability to join devices to Entra is restricted
Description: Restricts the ability to join new devices to Entra ID to authorized users or administrators. Prevents unauthorized device registration in the corporate directory.

Name: Ensure users are restricted from recovering BitLocker keys
Description: Configures Entra ID to prevent standard users from recovering BitLocker keys from Entra ID. Ensures key recovery requires appropriate authorization.

Name: Ensure the maximum number of devices per user is limited
Description: Limits the maximum number of devices each user can register in Entra ID to control device proliferation. Prevents excessive device registrations that could indicate compromise.

Name: Ensure the option to remain signed in is hidden
Description: Hides the 'Stay signed in' option on the Microsoft 365 sign-in page to prevent persistent sessions on shared or public computers.

Name: Ensure only people in my org can bypass the lobby
Description: Configures Teams meeting lobby policies to ensure only organization members can bypass the lobby. Prevents unauthorized participants from entering meetings unvetted.

Name: Web Content filtering shall be configured
Description: Configures web content filtering in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to block access to malicious and inappropriate web categories. Reduces the risk of drive-by downloads and policy violations.

Name: Automatic forwarding to external domains SHALL be disabled
Description: Disables automatic forwarding of email to external domains at the Exchange Online transport level. Prevents data exfiltration and business email compromise via automatic forwarding.

Name: Leverage Entra ID as your primary IDP
Description: Establishes Microsoft Entra ID as the primary Identity Provider for all organizational authentication. Centralizes identity governance and security policy enforcement.

Name: Procedures in place which require service providers with access to the Applicant’s systems or  the Applicant’s confidential information to demonstrate adequate network security controls
Description: Requires third-party service providers with access to organizational systems or data to demonstrate adequate security controls. Manages supply chain risk through vendor security assessment.

Name: Compliant with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards
Description: Ensures the organization maintains compliance with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS). Required for handling payment card data.

Name: HIPAA compliant
Description: Ensures the organization maintains HIPAA compliance for handling protected health information. Required for healthcare-related data processing.

Name: Engage a technical support specialist for your organization
Description: Engages a qualified technical support specialist to provide ongoing security support and guidance. Ensures expertise is available for security incidents and configuration management.

Name: Engage a technical support specialist for your organization-SLA
Description: Establishes a Service Level Agreement with technical support specialists defining response time requirements. Ensures timely response to security incidents.

Name: Install Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates on all public internet facing websites
Description: Installs and maintains valid TLS certificates on all public internet-facing websites. Protects data in transit and ensures browser trust for organizational web services.

Name: Purchase and maintain business or cyber insurance
Description: Purchases and maintains business or cyber insurance coverage to reduce financial risk from cybersecurity incidents. Provides financial protection against breach costs, ransomware, and liability.

Name: Ensure additional storage providers are restricted in Outlook on the web
Description: Restricts additional storage providers (Dropbox, Box, Google Drive) in Outlook on the web to prevent data exfiltration to unapproved cloud storage.

Name: Ensure only organizers and co-organizers can present
Description: Configures Teams meeting policies to ensure only organizers and co-organizers can present in meetings. Prevents attendees from taking over meeting presentation without authorization.

Name: Custom Lockout Requirements are configured in Entra ID
Description: Configures custom account lockout settings in Entra ID Smart Lockout to prevent brute-force attacks. Sets appropriate lockout thresholds and durations.

Name: Non-admin users shall be prevented from providing consent to 3rd party applications
Description: Prevents non-administrator users from providing consent to third-party applications accessing organizational data. All app consent must be granted by administrators after review.

Name: Unmanaged users SHALL NOT be enabled to initiate contact with internal users.
Description: Configures Teams to prevent unmanaged external users from initiating contact with internal users. Reduces unsolicited external communication and potential social engineering.

Name: Ensure Guest Users are reviewed at least monthly
Description: Reviews guest user accounts at least monthly to identify and remove accounts that are no longer needed. Prevents accumulation of stale guest accounts with persistent access.

Name: Dormant accounts are disabled after 45 days
Description: Automatically disables user accounts after 45 days of inactivity. Reduces the attack surface by preventing dormant accounts from being compromised and used for unauthorized access.

Name: Corporate applications are configured for SCIM provisioning
Description: Configures SCIM automatic provisioning for corporate applications to synchronize user lifecycle with Entra ID. Ensures accounts are automatically created and deprovisioned as users join and leave.

Name: Guest users have limited access to properties and memberships of directory objects
Description: Configures guest users to have limited access to directory objects and membership information. Prevents guests from enumerating organizational users and groups.

Name: Dynamic Groups are leveraged for automated group management
Description: Leverages dynamic group rules to automate group membership based on user attributes. Reduces manual administration errors and ensures consistent group membership management.

Name: A formal process is in place for users to request guest access
Description: Defines a formal process for users to request guest access to organizational resources. Ensures guest invitations are reviewed and approved before being sent.

Name: Only users with the Guest Inviter Role are allowed to invite external users
Description: Restricts external user invitations to users with the Guest Inviter role only. Prevents any user from inviting external guests, reducing uncontrolled guest account creation.

Name: Dormant Users Shall Not have a License
Description: Removes licenses from dormant user accounts to reduce cost and attack surface. Dormant licensed accounts can be used by attackers to access M365 services.

Name: Microsoft 365 group creation is disabled tenant-wide
Description: Disables Microsoft 365 group creation for all users and restricts it to designated groups. Prevents ungoverned proliferation of Microsoft 365 groups.

Name: Ensure employees have individual user accounts
Description: Ensures each employee has their own individual user account rather than sharing credentials. Provides accountability and accurate audit trail for all user actions.

Name: Enable Company Branding
Description: Enables and configures company branding on the Entra ID sign-in page. Helps users identify the authentic sign-in page and can deter phishing by making impersonation more obvious.

Name: Ensure 'LinkedIn account connections' is disabled
Description: Disables LinkedIn account connections in Entra ID to prevent exposure of organizational user data to LinkedIn. Reduces information disclosure through social network integrations.

Name: Ensure a dynamic group for guest users is created
Description: Creates a dynamic group that automatically includes all guest users in the tenant. Enables consistent policy application to all guests through this group.

Name: Ensure that collaboration invitations are sent to allowed domains only
Description: Restricts B2B collaboration invitations to approved domains only. Prevents guest invitations from being sent to unauthorized external organizations.

Name: Enable Identity Protection user risk policies
Description: Enables Entra ID Identity Protection user risk policies to automatically respond to high-risk users with MFA challenges or password resets.

Name: Ensure users dialing in can't bypass the lobby
Description: Configures Teams meeting settings to prevent dial-in callers from bypassing the lobby. Ensures all meeting participants, including phone callers, are vetted.

Name: Ensure access to APIs by Service Principals is restricted
Description: Restricts service principal access to Microsoft Graph and other APIs to specific approved permissions. Prevents over-permissioned service principals from accessing unauthorized data.

Name: Ensure Service Principals cannot create and use profiles
Description: Prevents service principals from creating LinkedIn profiles or similar social identities. Reduces the risk of service principals being used for social engineering.

Name: A user onboarding process is defined
Description: Defines and documents a formal user onboarding process including account creation, device enrollment, and security training. Ensures consistent and secure provisioning of new users.

Name: A user offboarding process is defined
Description: Defines and documents a formal user offboarding process including account disabling, device wipe, and access revocation. Ensures timely removal of access when users leave.

Name: Non-admin users shall be prevented from providing consent to 3rd party applications
Description: Prevents non-admin users from consenting to third-party application permissions. Duplicate control reinforcing admin-only consent requirement.

Name: Ensure users cannot create security groups
Description: Prevents users from creating security groups in Entra ID. Restricts group creation to administrators to maintain control over access permissions.

Name: Ensure service principals ability to create workspaces, connections and deployment pipelines is restricted
Description: Restricts service principals from creating workspaces, connections, and deployment pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Prevents automated processes from creating uncontrolled data resources.

Name: An incident response plan to respond to a network intrusion
Description: Defines and maintains an incident response plan specifically for network intrusion scenarios. Ensures the organization can respond effectively to cyberattacks with predefined processes and responsibilities.

Name: A disaster recovery plan, business continuity plan, or equivalent to respond to a computer  system disruption
Description: Defines and maintains a disaster recovery plan and business continuity plan for system disruption scenarios. Ensures operational continuity following major incidents.

Name: Cybersecurity events are analyzed in a timely manner to identify cybersecurity incidents
Description: Establishes processes to analyze cybersecurity events in a timely manner to identify and classify cybersecurity incidents. Reduces dwell time by enabling rapid incident identification.

Name: Cybersecurity incidents are reported to the chief information security officer, or one of their delegates, as soon as possible after they occur or are discovered.
Description: Establishes processes to report cybersecurity incidents to the CISO or designated delegate as soon as possible. Ensures executive awareness and enables timely decision-making during incidents.

Name: Cybersecurity incidents are reported to ASD as soon as possible after they occur or are discovered.
Description: Establishes processes to report cybersecurity incidents to the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) as required. Fulfills regulatory reporting obligations for Australian government agencies.

Name: Following the identification of a cybersecurity incident, the cybersecurity incident response plan is enacted.
Description: Establishes that the cybersecurity incident response plan is formally enacted following incident identification. Ensures consistent execution of response procedures.

Name: Backups of data, applications and settings are performed and retained in accordance with business criticality and business continuity requirements
Description: Ensures backups are performed and retained according to business criticality and continuity requirements. Provides the recovery capability needed to restore operations after an incident.

Name: Entra ID sign-in logs are periodically reviewed to identify assets trying to access the network
Description: Periodically reviews Entra ID sign-in logs to identify unauthorized access attempts and anomalous sign-in patterns. Enables detection of compromised accounts and unauthorized access attempts.

Name: Cloud App Discovery is configured and apps are periodically reviewed
Description: Configures Cloud App Discovery in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and periodically reviews discovered applications. Provides visibility into shadow IT and unsanctioned application usage.

Name: Audit Logging SHALL Be EnabledPassPass
Description: Enables Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Logging to capture user and admin activity across all M365 services. Unified audit logs are the foundation for security investigation and compliance reporting.

Name: Define an audit log retention and review process
Description: Defines a process for retaining and reviewing audit logs on a regular schedule. Ensures audit logs are preserved for forensic use and reviewed for anomalous activity.

Name: Audit Logging SHALL Be Enabled
Description: Enables Unified Audit Logging in Microsoft 365 to capture activity across Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and other services. Duplicate control reinforcing audit log enablement.

Name: Ensure 'AuditDisabled' organizationally is set to 'False'
Description: Verifies that the AuditDisabled organization configuration is set to False to ensure unified audit logging is active. Prevents accidental disabling of organizational audit logging.

Name: Entra ID logs shall be collected
Description: Configures collection and export of Entra ID sign-in and audit logs to a SIEM or storage account. Provides persistent log retention beyond the default Entra ID log retention period.

Name: Microsoft Sentinel shall be configured to ingest log information
Description: Configures Microsoft Sentinel to ingest log information from Microsoft 365 and Azure services. Enables centralized security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response automation.

Name: Periodically Review audit logs for Guest Users and Service Principals
Description: Periodically reviews audit logs for guest user and service principal activity to detect unauthorized access or privilege escalation.

Name: Incidents and Alerts are triaged in the Defender admin center
Description: Triages security incidents and alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR admin center to prioritize and respond to threats. Ensures security alerts are reviewed and actioned in a timely manner.

Name: Attack simulations shall be periodically conducted
Description: Conducts periodic attack simulation training via Microsoft Defender Attack Simulator to test user security awareness and identify vulnerability to phishing and other attacks.

Name: Azure AD Audit logs are periodically reviewed to identify assets trying to access the network
Description: Periodically reviews Azure AD audit logs to identify unauthorized access attempts and administrative activities. Provides governance oversight of directory changes.

Name: Azure AD Logs shall be collected
Description: Configures collection of Azure AD logs (sign-in, audit, provisioning) for retention and analysis. Ensures identity-related logs are available for security investigation.

Name: Event logs are protected from unauthorized modification and deletion
Description: Protects event logs from unauthorized modification and deletion to maintain log integrity. Tampered logs cannot be trusted for forensic investigation or compliance.

Name: Event logs from internet-facing servers are analyzed in a timely manner to detect cybersecurity events
Description: Analyzes event logs from internet-facing servers in a timely manner to detect cybersecurity events. Internet-facing systems are the primary targets for external attacks.

Name: Event logs from non-internet-facing servers are analyzed in a timely manner to detect cybersecurity events.
Description: Analyzes event logs from non-internet-facing servers in a timely manner to detect internal threats and lateral movement activity.

Name: Event logs from workstations are analyzed in a timely manner to detect cybersecurity events
Description: Analyzes event logs from workstations to detect user-initiated threats and malware execution. Workstations are the primary initial access vector for most attacks.

Name: Browser Sessions shall not be persistent for privileged users
Description: Configures Conditional Access to prevent persistent browser sessions for privileged administrator accounts. Ensures admins must reauthenticate for each session, reducing risk from stolen session tokens.

Name: Local Administrator settings are configured for device joins
Description: Configures local administrator settings for devices joining Entra ID, ensuring appropriate local admin accounts are created during the join process.

Name: Enable Microsoft Entra Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS)
Description: Enables Microsoft Entra Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) to automatically rotate and manage local administrator passwords. Prevents lateral movement using shared local admin credentials.

Name: Break Glass users are created for emergency access
